title: VIBEGRAPH.md front matter
description: The YAML front matter of VIBEGRAPH.md, the root file of a vibegraph, per the vibegraph.md specification 2.0 (SPEC.md section 3.1).

vibegraph.description: The specification version this vibegraph targets, as MAJOR.MINOR.

owner.description: The display name of the one person this vibegraph represents.

identity.description: Relative path to the identity file, identity/<owner-slug>.md.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the last change to any part of the vibegraph.
